text: {"lessons":["My account rose from about NT$100,594 to NT$109,499 before falling to NT$105,791; a late decline does not erase the earlier gain or reliably predict what comes next.","I made no trades, and the account still experienced sizable ups and downs; holding is also a decision, so I should check that my overall risk remains appropriate.","Because I rarely trade and losses weigh heavily on me, I should avoid reacting impulsively to a bad month and make any changes deliberately, based on my needs rather than recent price moves."]}
